name: Wilford Woodruff
role: Apostle and later President of the Church
dateNote: Section 118 named him to the Twelve on 8 July 1838; he was ordained at Far West on 26 April 1839.
importance: Wilford Woodruff joined at the end of 1833, and section 118 names him to fill a vacancy in the Twelve in 1838. He served in Britain from 1839 to 1841, and section 124 lists him among the apostles. Section 136 assigns him with Orson Pratt to organize a company in 1847. He presided over the Church from 1889 to 1898, and section 138 sees him among the spirits of the dead.
connections: He married Phebe Carter in 1837. Section 118 names him with John Taylor, John E. Page, and Willard Richards.

sources.title: Wilford Woodruff, Joseph Smith Papers biography
